title: Yerevan - Oct 16,  On the sidelines of the Summit of the 17th Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity, Dr. Masoud Pezeshkian, President of the Islamic Republic of Iran, met and held talks with Mr. Irakli Kobakhidze.
